metadata.primary_source: ACDH-CH HistoGIS Italia 1870-10-10–1919-12-31, with local modern Trentino-Alto Adige regional-boundary correction at the historic Stelvio tripoint
metadata.rationale: Use the state-border layer as primary authority for the Austria-Hungary–Italy external frontier. Crownland layers are retained as secondary cross-checks because the Tyrol layer contains multi-kilometre local divergence from the state-border layer.

tripoint_local_correction.reason: HistoGIS Italy/Switzerland state polygons misplace the local three-state junction; Piz da las Trais Linguas is retained as the verified pre-1919 tripoint.

properties.name: Austria-Hungary–Kingdom of Italy border, 1914
properties.method: Hybrid external frontier: modern Trentino-Alto Adige regional boundary for the historical Stelvio tripoint correction, then HistoGIS Italy state-border geometry; fixed historical anchors retained.

properties.name: Tyrol–Kingdom of Italy border, 1914
properties.method: 1914 Tyrol–Italy frontier with local Stelvio correction from the surviving modern Trentino-Alto Adige regional boundary, rejoining HistoGIS at [10.53971197373467,46.49270416373264].

properties.name: Carinthia–Kingdom of Italy border, 1914
properties.method: Italy state-border geometry used as primary external frontier; fixed historical junction anchors applied.

properties.name: Gorizia and Gradisca–Kingdom of Italy border, 1914
properties.method: Italy state-border geometry used as primary external frontier; fixed historical junction anchors applied.
